attributes.name: Ice Chemist
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to add the Cold trait to your check. 

On a character at your location's check that invokes the Cold trait, reveal this card to add 1d4. 

Discard this card to explore your location; during this exploration, you may add 1d8 and the Cold trait to your combat or Disable checks.
